title: Lender provides £3.25m loan for City Road hostel refinance
summary:
Specialist lender MERA has provided a £3.25 million stabilisation loan to refinance a 131-bed hostel on City Road, London. The 24-month bridging facility allows the borrower to establish a trading history before securing longer-term financing.

title: Maslow Capital provides £136.8m refinance for Manchester towers
summary:
Maslow Capital has completed a £136.8 million refinance for two residential towers at Circle Square in Manchester, secured against the North and East Towers on the Oxford Road corridor. The facility enables Vita Group to repay existing debt and acquire its joint venture partner's interest in both buildings.

title: Mezzanine funder launches development arm with £40m scheme
summary:
Iron Bridge Finance has launched a property development division with construction underway on a 44-home scheme in Islington valued at £40m. The firm, which has provided over £330m in mezzanine and equity funding since 2014, is now seeking additional development opportunities across London and the South-East.

title: Design-focused estate agency opens in London market
summary:
A new residential estate agency has opened in London with a focus on properties characterised by architectural design and interior detailing. Orato Estates, founded by Andreas Abasaid, will concentrate on homes including period restorations, architecturally distinctive properties and those with designed interiors.

The post Design-focused estate agency opens in London market appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: New Scottish rental laws introduce damp and mould duties
summary:
Scotland has implemented new rental regulations as of 6th October 2026, introducing stricter requirements for landlords and letting agents regarding damp and mould, tenancy succession, and wrongful termination penalties. Landlords must now ensure damp and mould investigations are completed within 10 working days, with remedial work beginning within five working days where substantial issues are identified.

title: Average rental yields reach 7.9% as landlord portfolios expand
summary:
Average rental yields in the UK have reached 7.9%, whilst landlords now hold an average of 18 properties in their portfolios, according to new research from Fleet Mortgages covering the third quarter of 2026. The data shows yields increased by 0.4 percentage points compared to the same period in 2025.

title: Conservative shadow minister proposes stamp duty abolition
summary:
Shadow Housing Secretary Katie Lam has outlined proposals to abolish Stamp Duty and scrap the Future Homes Standard, alongside plans to reduce new-build housing costs by up to £50,000. The measures were announced at the Conservative Party annual conference.

The post Conservative shadow minister proposes stamp duty abolition appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Online mortgage calculators show limitations for buyers
summary:
Online mortgage calculators may provide inaccurate borrowing estimates for prospective homebuyers, according to mortgage brokers who have highlighted the tools' limitations in assessing individual circumstances. The calculators frequently fail to account for complex income sources and financial commitments.

The post Online mortgage calculators show limitations for buyers appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Moving costs fall 2.3% but remain 74% higher than decade ago
summary:
The cost of moving home in England has declined to £17,413, down 2.3% from 2025's record high, according to analysis of 204,000 quotes by reallymoving. However, moving costs remain 74% higher than a decade ago when adjusted for inflation, creating barriers to household mobility and market activity.

title: Paragon Bank provides £3.8m for Bath apartment conversion
summary:
Paragon Bank has completed a £3.8m development finance facility for the conversion of a historic office building in Bath city centre into 15 private apartments. The transaction marks the lender's second deal with ORM Developments, with the scheme carrying an estimated gross development value of approximately £6.2m.
